title: first_upgradeable returns -1 sentinel for an id-less asset, unlike oldest_damaged_repairable's skip-and-continue
evidence:
+		var asset_id := int(asset.get("id", -1))
+		if asset_id < 0:
+			continue
...and in first_upgradeable:
+		if cost >= 0 and state.get("balance", 0) >= cost:
+			return int(asset.get("id", -1))
+	return -1
detail: oldest_damaged_repairable does `continue` on a missing id so a later valid damaged asset can win; first_upgradeable returns int(asset.get("id", -1)) = -1 immediately, suppressing later valid upgradeable assets under ragged state.
recommended_fix: Mirror the guard: `var asset_id := int(asset.get("id", -1)); if asset_id < 0: continue` before returning, so a ragged first asset doesn't mask later valid upgradeable assets.

title: Adversarial review cites 285 checks; PR body/story/memlog cite 295 for the same headless command
evidence:
+  - `godot --headless --path game --script res://tests/test_economy.gd` → **285 checks, 0 failures, exit 0** (commit message's "285 bare-runner checks" is accurate; base was 241 checks, 0 failures)
...and in the PR body:
+- `godot --headless --path game --script res://tests/test_economy.gd` → exit 0, **295 checks / 0 failures** (base: 241)
detail: Same headless command reported as 285 checks in the adversarial review and 295 in the PR body/story/memlog. Reconcilable by commit (review pins f7140c6) but the diff never states the +10 reconciliation.
recommended_fix: Add one line to the PR body or review noting the fix commit raised the count 285→295, so the two figures in the diff reconcile explicitly.
